_comment: Single source of the proxy override setting (Issue 101, point 2): its storage key, its default (automatic: the system settings, PAC included) and the token that forces every download direct. Any other value is one relay URL, validated by core/network/engine/route_plan.lua. Read by core/network/engine/proxy_override.lua on macOS and Linux and by core/network/adapters/proxy_override.ahk on Windows, which holds the key in config.toml; vendor/ergopti_network_routes.ps1 hops through loopback for what WinHTTP cannot reach.
